thread:
Alex: quick q — PR for the migration guide (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842) is blocked from auto-merge even though it's docs-only. CODEOWNERS didn't get pinged, and auto-merge is waiting on `ci/full`. Anyone seen this pattern recently?
Mina: I saw something similar yesterday. GitHub auto-merge sometimes blocks when a check with `required` status isn't present on the PR. Which checks are required on this repo?
Alex: repo requires `ci/full` and `docs/preview` in the repo settings. The PR shows `docs/preview` passed but `ci/full` is missing (it never started).
Sam: ah, is the PR from a fork? Forks can't run some org-level runners, so `ci/full` might be disabled for forked PRs.
Alex: it's from an internal contributor branch, not a fork. logs show `ci/full` never queued. ci-bot: "ci/full was skipped due to changed files matching docs/** and a rule to skip full CI for docs-only."
docs-bot: "docs/preview passed — view at https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/842"
Jordana: if full ci is intentionally skipped for docs-only, auto-merge rules may still require the check name `ci/full` to exist (even if it's skipped). GH treats a missing required check as blocking. We either need to mark `ci/full` allowed to be skipped or adjust the branch protection rule to accept `docs/preview`.
Mina: +1 on changing branch protection. Another option: have the skip step create a dummy status check named `ci/full` with success when skipping. We already do that in some repos.
Alex: who owns the branch protection config? I can file a ticket but would prefer a quick change.
Jordana: platform-team owns it. @sam can you ping eng-infra? Also, we should avoid creating phantom checks unless we make them clearly named (`ci/full (skipped for docs)`) to avoid confusion.
Sam: pinged eng-infra. They asked: can you paste the exact branch protection required checks list?
Alex: copied from settings: required status checks: ["ci/full", "docs/preview", "codeowners/approval"]. CODEOWNERS is weird here — docs-only should bypass human approvals.
Mina: CODEOWNERS will apply if a path matches. Do we have a rule like `docs/** @docs-team`? If so, that forces at least one approval. We have an exception in the bot that auto-approves docs changes, but it's flaky.
Alex: here's the snippet of our CODEOWNERS file: ```/docs @docs-team /examples @examples-team``` It should request reviews but not block auto-merge if the PR is labelled `docs-only`. Problem is the label isn't being applied automatically.
Jordana: why isn't label-bot tagging it? Label-bot triggers on the `files` changed set. Maybe the migration guide touched `examples/` accidentally?
Alex: it didn't. I checked. Label-bot didn't run until after I pushed an amend. The sequence: push -> GH checks evaluate -> label-bot runs asynchronously -> auto-merge window passed. So auto-merge never saw the label.
Sam: Could we tweak the auto-merge rule to wait for `labels/ready` or rely on `docs/preview` exclusively? That reduces coupling to label-bot.
Mina: We should also make auto-merge tolerant of a `ci/full` check being absent when `docs/preview` is green and the PR size is small. Maybe a YAML config like: ```auto_merge:
  required_checks: ["docs/preview"]
  optional_checks: ["ci/full"]```
Alex: sounds good. For now, can someone manually approve & merge? It's blocking the migration demo tomorrow.
Jordana: I'll approve if you add a `docs:urgent` label. That will also trigger the manual OK workflow.
Alex: added `docs:urgent`. Thanks!
Sam: FYI eng-infra replied: "We can update branch protection to accept `docs/preview` instead of `ci/full` for the docs repo. We'll do it during the next maintenance window unless this is urgent."
Mina: short-term alternative: create a tiny GitHub Action that posts a successful status named `ci/full` when only docs files changed. Then auto-merge sees it and proceeds. We can keep it behind a toggle.
Alex: prefer infra change vs fake check. But either works. Thanks all — I'll follow up with eng-infra and file a quick RFC for the auto-merge config to be more docs-friendly. :thumbsup:
Jordana: one more note — if anyone else hits this, please mention the PR number and whether it originated from a fork or branch. That helps diagnose runner permissions.
Alex: will do. Closing for now.
